title: WorkPulse interview.cancelled v1
description: HR cancelled a scheduled interview. Identifiers and the acting user only — the cancellation note is PII and never leaves the database (`.ai/security.md`).

candidate_id.description: The candidate being interviewed (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012 — candidate fallback orders interviews with their candidate).

job_id.description: The job the candidate applied to (UUIDv7 string).

cancelled_by.description: Actor user id that cancelled the interview (ADR 0010).
